steps.action: Create an empty document and enter Unicode text
steps.expected: Empty state accepts typing immediately

steps.action: Save to scratch, close and reopen
steps.expected: Exact text and EOL survive reopen

steps.action: Undo and redo an edit
steps.expected: Undo restores prior text and redo restores edit

steps.action: Open generated UTF-8 code/config
steps.expected: Highlighting matches selected language

steps.action: Use completion and indentation
steps.expected: Completion and indentation preserve surrounding text

steps.action: Save and reopen
steps.expected: Saved configuration equals expected bytes

steps.action: Open multiline fixture and enable regex
steps.expected: Fixture loaded without mutation

steps.action: Preview captures and replace
steps.expected: Expected capture replacement count and bytes

steps.action: Undo replacement
steps.expected: Original bytes restored

steps.action: Select a rectangle across tabs, wide glyphs and a line shorter than the target display column
steps.expected: Selection and insertion targets follow display columns across all three line shapes

steps.action: Perform one column insertion across the selected rectangle
steps.expected: Inserted text appears at every intended display column, including on the short line

steps.action: Invoke Undo once
steps.expected: One undo transaction restores the original document

steps.action: Generate paged scratch log in bounded chunks and open
steps.expected: First viewport editable without whole-file materialization

steps.action: Search a boundary-spanning match
steps.expected: Correct global result selected

steps.action: Enable monitoring and append then rotate fixture
steps.expected: Append and rotation observed without stale content

steps.action: Open generated trusted workspace
steps.expected: Tree reflects only fixture workspace

steps.action: Navigate tree and symbol/outline
steps.expected: Correct document and target selected

steps.action: Rename scratch file and navigate again
steps.expected: Workspace and active document reflect rename

steps.action: Import fixture Notepad++ UDL XML
steps.expected: Import errors absent and language available

steps.action: Open sample matching its extension
steps.expected: Expected tokens styled with imported rules

steps.action: Restart and reopen sample
steps.expected: Imported definition remains available

steps.action: Record edit and search then save macro
steps.expected: Recorded operations preserve explicit arguments

steps.action: Restart and replay macro
steps.expected: Expected resulting document after replay

steps.action: Run controlled argv/output fixture and cancel descendant
steps.expected: Literal argv preserved, output navigates correctly and owned tree terminates

steps.action: Clone active fixture into secondary pane
steps.expected: Both panes show same document

steps.action: Edit and undo from each pane
steps.expected: Edits and undo reflect in both panes

steps.action: Enable synchronized scrolling
steps.expected: Scroll follows requested synchronization without stealing focus

steps.action: Open saved and unsaved fixtures and edit
steps.expected: Recovery journals track both documents

steps.action: Terminate owned editor during staged save
steps.expected: Original or complete replacement survives

steps.action: Restart isolated session and recover
steps.expected: Recovered text and provenance match accepted operations

steps.action: Install reviewed first-party fixture/runtime pack
steps.expected: Trust decision explicit and package verified

steps.action: Invoke JSON/XML/Hex capability
steps.expected: Result correct and document remains responsive

steps.action: Crash owned extension host then revoke
steps.expected: Editor survives; revoked capability cannot run

steps.action: Launch isolated portable package and change settings
steps.expected: Persistent state stays under portable root

steps.action: Close then relocate entire scratch package
steps.expected: No old absolute state path required

steps.action: Reopen offline
steps.expected: Settings/session load without installation

steps.action: Install signed fixture on disposable standard-user VM
steps.expected: Installed version/associations match chosen options

steps.action: Apply verified update with injected activation failure
steps.expected: Incomplete update never replaces working install

steps.action: Rollback and uninstall
steps.expected: Working version restored; no unwanted services/tasks/associations

steps.action: Open a fixture, press Ctrl+F and type a literal query
steps.expected: The Find field is the UIA focused element with keyboard focus, its value equals the typed query and the match count is announced; Escape returns focus to the Editor

steps.action: Type into a new Untitled document, press Ctrl+W and cancel the save prompt, then press Ctrl+W again and choose Don't Save
steps.expected: The prompt is owned by the editor; after each answer the window and every top-level menu are enabled and File > Exit stays available; Cancel keeps the text

steps.action: Clone a fixture into the second pane, give each pane its own caret and switch panes with F6
steps.expected: Exactly one pane provider has keyboard focus after each switch; typing lands at the focused pane's caret and shows in both panes

steps.action: Edit a generated paged document, press Ctrl+S and then Ctrl+W while the save is running
steps.expected: The close is deferred while the document is busy and completes once, without a save prompt, after the save; the saved bytes include the edit

steps.action: Exit cleanly with session restore enabled and relaunch twice
steps.expected: Each relaunch shows a visible, non-minimized window with a first frame and restores the saved document
